efile.text: Employers are required to file all withholding forms and remit all tax payments electronically.

epay.text: You are required to file all withholding forms electronically and pay any associated taxes by electronic funds transfer.

deposits.interpretation: Connecticut classifies each employer as a weekly, monthly or quarterly remitter from its reported Connecticut income tax withholding liability over a 12-month look-back (for 2025: the 12 months ended June 30, 2024). Weekly: more than $10,000. Monthly: more than $2,000 but not more than $10,000. Quarterly: $2,000 or less; most new employers are quarterly. DRS notifies the employer of its frequency by mail, so the frequency is an INPUT (or is derived from a supplied look-back liability). Weekly remitters remit by the Wednesday following the Saturday-to-Friday week in which wages were paid (paydays Saturday to Tuesday: the second Wednesday after the payday; Wednesday to Friday: the Wednesday after). A week spanning two quarters needs separate payments. Monthly: the 15th of the month after the wages were paid. Quarterly: with Form CT-941 by the last day of the month after the quarter. Annual remitters (by request, seasonal, household and agricultural employers) are not modelled. Connecticut's separate paid-leave contribution is not deposited with DRS and is not included.

lookback.description: Connecticut income tax withholding liability reported over the 12-month look-back period ended June 30 of the prior year

returns.name: Form CT-941, Connecticut Quarterly Reconciliation of Withholding
contents: Must be filed even if no tax is due or was withheld for the quarter (unless a seasonal, annual, agricultural or household employer filer).
Due: first quarter April 30, second July 31, third October 31, fourth January 31.
Quarterly remitters pay with the form.

returns.name: Form CT-W3, Connecticut Annual Reconciliation of Withholding
contents: Due on or before January 31; completed as part of the electronic filing when Copy 1 of every federal Form W-2 is uploaded.
Every Copy 1 of federal Form W-2 must be filed even if no Connecticut income tax was withheld.
No payment is made with this return.
